main_text.head: DE UNICO ET AETERNO TESTAMENTO, Oratio, habita à Promotore Ioh. Iacobo Grynæo, in Brabeuterio Academiae Basiliensis, die 28. Nouemb. 1583.

p.i: Cælatas ornant veluti mala aurea lances, Sic decus immensum fermo rotundus habet.

main_text.p: Licet enim heroici cuiusdam mei hospitis versibus uti, Magnifice Domine Rector, Generosi Barones, nobilitatis literatę flos, vosq; cæteri lectissimi & ingeniosissimi Auditores.

Ut tamen nostra, de unico & æterno dei testamento & fœdere (quo ille pro infinita sua bonitate & erga nos amore) Nos om-nes sibi iūxit[?], Oratio: rotunda & neutiquā inutilibus cyparisi fructibus adsimilis sit. Theorema theologicum, quo demonstratur veteris & noui testamenti ταυτότης, ordine Geometrico breuiter tractabimus, atque itā circulum nostri instituti absoluemus.

page.notes: Running head absent: the page opens the division. Doubtful readings: "iūxit" (macron over u, read as an abbreviation for iunxit), "arduū" (first letters of the word unclear). The middle of the Greek quotation in the last paragraph is illegible; the first and last words are read from the scan. The line-end hyphen in "om-nes" and "ingenio-sus" is printed.
